closed_primitives.architecture-progression-v1: Mask-side fine-label transition and native-pattern/lumen postconditions are implemented and tested; frozen-generator architecture response and pathology review are not yet validated.
closed_primitives.neoplastic-cell-infiltration-increase-v1: Deprecated ambiguous primitive. Use neoplastic-microinfiltration-increase-v1, invasive-front-expansion-v1, structural-void-spread-v1 or architecture-progression-v1.
closed_primitives.structural-void-spread-v1: Void-aware complete-instance containment and separation are implemented and tested; digest-bound native airspace/alveolar inputs and frozen-generator STAS response are not yet validated.
closed_primitives.tumor-burden-decrease-v1: A growth mechanism cannot be inverted into treatment response or regression. This primitive remains closed until a domain-specific, evidence-backed response mechanism and frozen-generator capability are validated.

closed_pairs.lung-generic-immune-compartment-turnover: The four top mask-ranked IGNITE cases produced three 300-second execution timeouts and one deterministic rejection, with no successful immune-compartment decrease. The pair cannot provide robust five-case execution under the current annotations and executor.
closed_pairs.lung-local-population-modulation::generi: None of 12 top IGNITE cases selected after corrected mask-component ranking satisfied the generic inflammatory complete-instance depletion contract. The pair cannot provide robust five-case execution, while the separate cell-type decrease remains executable.
closed_pairs.lung-local-population-modulation::neopla: None of six top IGNITE cases selected after corrected mask-component ranking provided a legal tumor zone satisfying complete neoplastic-instance depletion, the local gradient and residual population floors. The primitive cannot provide robust five-case execution.

The first three top IGNITE cases all exceeded the 240-second execution limit without producing a candidate summary. The mature executor cannot provide robust five-case neoplastic addition under the current runtime contract.
closed_pairs.lung-local-population-modulation::peritu: None of seven top IGNITE Tumor-Stroma interface cases could pack the required ten separated complete neoplastic foci; capacity was typically one or two. Lowering the topology floor would make the edit too small to be meaningful.

None of six top IGNITE Tumor-Stroma interface cases could pack the required eight separated complete cluster units; observed capacity was one to three. Lowering the topology floor would make the edit too small to be meaningful.
closed_pairs.oral-scc-local-population-modulation::ce: After mask-component-aware reranking, only the one preserved success remained and 11 further top ORCA cases failed the complete-instance depletion, three-band gradient or residual floors. The primitive cannot provide robust five-case execution.
closed_pairs.oral-scc-local-population-modulation::ge: ORCA binds this intent to the same inflammatory class and complete-instance depletion program as cell-type decrease, which remained 1-of-12 after corrected mask-component ranking. The primitive cannot provide robust five-case execution.
closed_pairs.melanoma-local-population-modulation::ce: After mask-component-aware reranking, only the one preserved success remained and 13 further top PUMA cases failed the complete-instance depletion, three-band gradient or residual floors. The primitive cannot provide robust five-case execution.
closed_pairs.melanoma-local-population-modulation::ge: PUMA binds this intent to the same inflammatory class and complete-instance depletion program as cell-type decrease, which remained 1-of-14 after corrected mask-component ranking. The primitive cannot provide robust five-case execution.
closed_pairs.melanoma-local-population-modulation::ne: None of 12 top PUMA cases selected after corrected mask-component ranking provided a legal tumor zone satisfying complete neoplastic-instance depletion, the local gradient and residual population floors. The primitive cannot provide robust five-case execution.

closed_mechanisms.breast-cohesive-nst-front: Breast execution no longer asks a general visual LLM to recognize a histologic invasive front. Use breast-annotation-anchored-boundary-growth or breast-infiltrative-nest-cord-extension.
closed_mechanisms.breast-discohesive-single-file: Breast execution no longer asks a general visual LLM to diagnose single-file morphology. Use breast-peritumoral-neoplastic-scatter for the mask-executable cell-only representation.
closed_mechanisms.colorectal-gland-forming-front: GLaS lacks explicit stromal authority and the attempted H&E/mask-derived gland-unit producer could not reliably distinguish lumen, mucin, necrosis and cleft. Keep tissue-level malignant-gland growth closed.
closed_mechanisms.lung-acinar-papillary-growth: IGNITE does not provide a digest-bound lumen or fibrovascular-core map. Acinar/papillary identity cannot be inferred from H&E because execution planning is mask-only.
closed_mechanisms.lung-lepidic-growth: IGNITE does not provide a digest-bound alveolar framework map. Lepidic growth cannot be executed without risking airspace filling, and H&E inference is prohibited.
closed_mechanisms.lung-local-tumor-clearance: The cross-validation annotation bundle has no user-supplied, digest-bound local_clearance_roi; automatic ROI invention would not be a mask-authorized local clearance.
closed_mechanisms.lung-stas-airspace-spread: STAS requires explicit alveolar/airspace authority. The current IGNITE bundle has no digest-bound airspace map, so mask-only execution must fail closed.
closed_mechanisms.melanoma-discohesive-junctional: PUMA epidermis labels do not identify a junctional melanoma component. Junctional/pagetoid spread cannot be inferred from H&E by the execution Planner; use the non-diagnostic Tumor-Stroma peritumoral-focus mechanism instead.
closed_mechanisms.melanoma-local-tumor-clearance: The cross-validation annotation bundle has no user-supplied, digest-bound local_clearance_roi; automatic ROI invention would not be mask-authorized local clearance.
closed_mechanisms.oral-scc-annotation-anchored-cord-extens: ORCA Other tissue is a heterogeneous non-carcinoma class and cannot certify a physiologically valid receiving substrate for an invasive cord without prohibited H&E interpretation.
closed_mechanisms.oral-scc-cohesive-nest-cord: ORCA Other tissue is a heterogeneous non-carcinoma class. A mask-only Planner cannot guarantee that boundary expansion preserves mucosa, muscle, salivary tissue, nerves and vessels.
closed_mechanisms.oral-scc-dispersed-invasive-front: ORCA Other tissue cannot identify a safe stromal invasive front. Placing carcinoma nuclei outside Tumor would risk mucosa, muscle, salivary, nerve or vascular compartments that are not encoded.
closed_mechanisms.oral-scc-local-carcinoma-clearance: The cross-validation annotation bundle has no user-supplied, digest-bound local_clearance_roi, and ORCA has no specific receiving stroma label.
closed_mechanisms.oral-scc-operational-tumor-retreat: ORCA has no explicit stroma or treatment-bed class. Tumor-to-Other-tissue replacement would overclaim post-treatment physiology from a heterogeneous annotation label.
closed_mechanisms.prostate-pattern-3-growth: The current generic interface-band executor cannot insert separated complete pattern-3 glands and has produced gland bridging or circumferential wall thickening. Keep this mechanism closed until a whole-gland-unit executor and paired frozen-generator validation exist.
closed_mechanisms.melanoma-peritumoral-small-focus: Representative PUMA Tumor-Stroma boundaries could not reach the minimum four complete scatter foci, while mature small-cluster replay degraded capacity witnesses into singleton foci. Keep both primitives closed until a cluster-aware executor preserves multi-cell topology without lowering the visible-effect floor.
closed_mechanisms.melanoma-cohesive-nest-sheet: Forty top mask-ranked PUMA patches failed at the 14% visible-area floor, and retries at the 5-8% compartment floor still had zero nuclei-safe interface capacity. The shared cohesive growth executor therefore cannot implement either supported primitive under the current annotations.
closed_mechanisms.melanoma-operational-tumor-retreat: Top mask-ranked PUMA retries at both the 14% visible-area floor and the 5-8% compartment floor had zero nuclei-safe Tumor-to-Stroma interface capacity. The three shared retreat programs cannot execute without cutting complete annotated nuclei.
closed_mechanisms.lung-solid-squamous-growth: Corrected mask ranking and 12 top IGNITE retries still produced no executable cohesive interface at a 4% visible-area floor; failures were deterministic replanning stalls or zero nuclei-safe capacity. Both shared growth primitives therefore remain closed.
closed_mechanisms.lung-generic-immune-compartment-turnover: Immune-compartment decrease produced three 300-second timeouts and one deterministic rejection, while the first three ranked increase cases had zero nuclei-safe interface capacity. The shared tissue-compartment mechanism cannot provide robust five-case execution.
closed_mechanisms.lung-intratumoral-necrosis-turnover: All six mask-ranked appearance cases and all three mask-ranked resolution cases had zero nuclei-safe tissue capacity at the 5% visible-area floor. The shared turnover mechanism cannot execute without cutting complete annotated nuclei under the current authority.
closed_mechanisms.melanoma-intratumoral-necrosis-turnover: None of the 189 PUMA cross-validation targets has both the required Tumor-Necrosis contact and the 8% visible donor compartment for appearance or resolution. Both primitives are unavailable under the current annotation distribution.
closed_mechanisms.lung-stromal-invasive-front: The first five corrected-rank IGNITE cases all failed native instance preflight because the hybrid partition could not authorize complete-nucleus removal; one also lacked the required native reference class. Cord extension is unavailable under the current authority.
closed_mechanisms.lung-operational-tumor-retreat: The first three top IGNITE tumor-interface cases all failed native instance preflight because the hybrid partition could not authorize complete-nucleus removal. The three shared retreat programs are unavailable under the current authority.
